name: What is the typical cost range for a kitchen addition in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a kitchen addition in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen addition in the Bay Area varies significantly based on size, material choices, and complexity. Smaller additions focused on expanding an existing kitchen might start around $75,000 to $150,000. Larger, more complex additions involving structural changes, new foundations, and high-end finishes can range from $150,000 to $300,000 or more. These figures generally include design, permits, labor, and materials, but specific costs depend on individual project details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen addition costs in the Bay Area typically range from $75,000 for smaller projects to over $300,000 for larger, more complex ones, depending on materials and scope.
